love.text: ... I don't know what to say except... thank you

like.text: How thoughtful. I will keep this.

neutral.text: Not quite my taste but your heart is in the right place I suppose

dislike.text: ... do not go out of your way next time.

hate.text: Do you have a death wish? If it belongs in the bin do not gift it to me.

items.text: Void Essence... I used to use power like this to bring down empires. To hold it here... it is a jarring juxtaposition. Thank you.
This light... glows exactly like Holy materia... A beautiful relic of a bygone time... I will guard it with my life.
This... reminds me of... less joyful moments of my life that I'd rather not revist
I would've loved to have smashed a pair of glasses like these... on a certain scientist's face... while he wore them... Thanks
Not quite my colour but... Your intentions are incredibly thoughtful. Thank you.
(Smiles while laughing whilst he takes it) Perhaps you understand me better than I think you do.
Reminds me of a place I spend much of my life encased- surrounded by... It was so... peaceful

A tulip? Huh... It's actually kind of beautiful. It reminds me of a song... about a freezing night in the city where two people share a jacket to keep warm. About drying your tears and building something real. Thank you... Let's let this be our opportunity.
Blood-red beneath a bitter rind... how fitting. It reminds me of the story of Hades, standing in the silent dark, offering a lonely queen a reason to stay... only... you've reversed our roles...
Huh! You trying to start a 'life' with me? kidding...
... this... reminds me of a past I'd rather not remember.
